commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Envy of what others gain, craving for the objects of the senses, the anger towards others that these cause and the harsh words that anger brings: righteousness is what goes on without a break, free of these four. Whatever is mixed with them isn’t righteousness. This couplet and the last tell its nature.
